name: @cocreate/workflows
description: Declarative client actions and tenant-scoped server execution for CoCreate workflows.

interface.summary: Loads and executes organization-scoped workflow records using CoCreate AST.

attributes.name: workflow
attributes.role: Declares one or more workflow names and scopes each workflow action to its container.

attributes.name: {name}-key
attributes.role: Maps element values into the first object in the named workflow input array. If keyed values were collected, the evaluated response is passed to setData.

attributes.name: {workflowName}
attributes.role: Marks this element as a workflow event source and contributes its mapped attributes and live value as an input object.

attributes.name: {workflowName}-on
attributes.role: Registers native event listeners on the marked element and runs the workflow using only that element's data; input and change are debounced for 1 second.

actions.name: {workflowName}
actions.description: Runs the named workflow for its nearest declaring container.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Registers workflow actions and native {workflowName}-on event listeners for existing or supplied workflow containers.

response.description: Optional client-side response AST. The client evaluates it with $this set to the event source and $payload set to the returned envelope. Its result is passed to setData only when the request collected {name}-key values.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Binds server services and returns the workflow handler for registration on the workflow socket event.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Resolves a workflow by method name, executes ordered actions with $data referencing the original envelope, and appends errors to envelope.error.

author: CoCreate LLC
